name: Aurora Memoria - Philosophical Data Session: 2093
source: You play as a student accepted as a member of the Accelerated Class in Fuji Academy. During your philosophy class you are paired with one of the three possible partners and your life takes a completely different turn based on which one you choose.
translation: 你将扮演一名被富士学院加速班录取的学生。在哲学课上，你会与三名候选搭档中的一人配对；你选择谁，将让人生走向完全不同的方向。
